item: SKOS reader: SKOS-XL labels are read, language entries are pruned (0.6.1 EuroVoc follow-ups a, c)
summary: skosxl:prefLabel/altLabel are resolved after the stream (plain label of a language wins; unresolved reference is the named gap xl_label_unresolved); per-element language entries are dropped when the element ends; a dropped unlanguaged top-level label deliberately stays a label_without_language gap (b), pinned by a test.
